clusters.headline: India Joins Global Coalition To Secure Artificial Intelligence Supply
aiSummaryBullets: India joined a ten-nation coalition led by the United States to secure artificial intelligence supply chains against competition from China.
The European Union imposed anti-dumping duties on steel exports arriving from India and four other nations.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Stays Allahabad HC Probe Order On Rahul Gandhi Assets
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court overturned an Allahabad High Court directive requiring federal agencies to probe assets linked to Rahul Gandhi.
The top court mandated that the Congress leader be formally added as a party in the ongoing High Court legal proceedings.

clusters.headline: Samajwadi Party And Congress Clash Over Uttar Pradesh Seat Sharing
aiSummaryBullets: Samajwadi Party offered Congress 26 assembly seats, a figure lower than expected, during alliance negotiations.
Congress leaders expressed frustration over the unilateral announcement of candidates and seat numbers by the Samajwadi Party.

clusters.headline: Assam Man Rahul Roy Arrested For Alleged Rape Of Nine-Year-Old
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Roy was taken into custody following allegations of sexually assaulting a nine-year-old girl in Assam.
The mother of the child claimed the abuse occurred multiple times, coming to light after the girl fell ill.

clusters.headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Milk Price Hike And Latest Market Updates
aiSummaryBullets: Tax authorities imposed a penalty for a cash-based property transaction between family members.
Insurance companies face rulings over compensation claims for vehicle damages and technical issues.

clusters.headline: Indian Cabinet Approves Silchar Airport And Infrastructure Projects
aiSummaryBullets: The Union Cabinet approved the construction of a new greenfield airport in Silchar, Assam, with an allocated budget of Rs 2,014 crore.
A broader package totaling Rs 19,934 crore was cleared, featuring support for construction equipment manufacturing and infrastructure initiatives.

clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu Faces Legal Scrutiny Over Karthigai Deepam Ritual Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Madurai District Collector issued an apology to the Supreme Court for failing to light the ritual lamp at the Deepathoon pillar as previously ordered.
Legal disputes persist regarding the site of the Karthigai Deepam lighting, involving deliberations between the Madras High Court and Supreme Court.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Announces Rs 15,000 Crore Development Package For Nepal
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a Rs 15,000 crore economic development package for Nepal.
The commitment followed a bilateral meeting between the Prime Minister and Balen Shah.

clusters.headline: Security Forces Intensify Operations Following Kulgam Terror Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Security operations are ongoing in Kulgam following a November ambush that left three Central Reserve Police Force personnel wounded.
Intelligence reports indicate 65 foreign terrorists are currently active in Kashmir, with many linked to Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammed.

clusters.headline: India 3rd Biggest Asian Power, PM Modi 2nd Most Effective Leader: Report
aiSummaryBullets: NDTV reports: India 3rd Biggest Asian Power, PM Modi 2nd Most Effective Leader: Report
Times of India reports: US, China, India top Asia power rankings; PM Modi ranks 2nd to Xi as leader

clusters.headline: Meta Updates Instagram Content Recommendation Systems In India
aiSummaryBullets: Meta has adjusted recommendation settings on Instagram for users located in India.
The updates aim to decrease the visibility of content deemed suggestive or likely to incite violence.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Cabinet Approves State Renaming To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: The West Bengal cabinet officially approved the proposal to rename the state to Paschim Banga in both Hindi and English.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari is scheduled to introduce the formal motion for this renaming process in the legislative assembly on December 9.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi Police Serve Summons To TVK MLA Arul Vignesh In Case
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi police delivered a summons to TVK MLA Arul Vignesh at his residence as part of an active investigation.
The state government established a four-member committee to investigate sexual harassment allegations against the MLA.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: The renewed BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal alliance brings new political challenges ahead of Punjab…
aiSummaryBullets: India Today reports: The renewed BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal alliance brings new political challenges ahead of Punjab elections
The Hindu reports: BJP, Akali Dal reunite ahead of Punjab polls as Sukhbir Badal brings SAD back to NDA

clusters.headline: FSSAI Expands National Water Checks Following Bisleri Safety Probe
aiSummaryBullets: The FSSAI has launched comprehensive, pan-India laboratory testing of packaged drinking water brands.
The regulator initiated prosecution proceedings against Bisleri after a water sample from a Goa batch failed quality tests.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.

Times of India reports: Nepal PM Balen Shah arrives in India for first visit; talks with PM Modi on Monday

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Addresses Political Criticism Following Family Loss
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended his mother's final rites in Haridwar following her passing at age 91.
The Chief Minister has engaged in verbal exchanges with political rivals, including criticism directed at the Samajwadi Party.
